questions.question: Your agent gets 'connection refused' calling http://localhost:11434. What's the most likely cause?
options: The model's context window is full
questions.explanation: Port 11434 is the Ollama server. 'Connection refused' means nothing is listening, so start it with `ollama serve` or the desktop app.

questions.question: Why does agent-doctor skip models like nomic-embed-text when choosing one to ping?
options: Embedding models turn text into vectors and cannot hold a conversation
questions.explanation: Embedding models output vectors for search. Sending them a chat request fails or returns nothing useful.

questions.question: What is the safe way for a diagnostic script to report API keys?
options: Print the full key so you can verify it
Print the first and last four characters
Print only the names of the environment variables that are set
Write the keys to a log file
questions.explanation: Report which keys exist, never their values. Terminal output and logs get shared, pasted, and committed.

questions.question: Why does every lesson use the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions format?
options: It's the only format that supports tools
Ollama, OpenAI, vLLM, LM Studio and others accept it, so switching providers is just a base-URL change
It is faster than other formats
questions.explanation: One request shape works across local and hosted servers, which keeps lesson code provider-neutral.

questions.question: You accidentally committed an API key and then deleted it in the next commit. What must you do?
options: Rotate (revoke and replace) the key, because it's still in git history
questions.explanation: The key remains in history and may already be scraped. Revoking it is the only real fix.

questions.question: Why do the checks take parameters like which=shutil.which and fetch=fetch_json?
options: So tests can pass in fake functions without patching libraries or needing Ollama installed
questions.explanation: Injecting dependencies with real defaults keeps production code simple and tests fast and deterministic.
